Rooms by the sea

Quiet rooms a short walk from the harbour, with breakfast served until noon.

Rooms, prices and the way here

Our rooms

Each room has a desk, a window that opens and a bed made up with cotton sheets. We follow the WCAG guidance for every page we publish, and the rooms on the ground floor have step-free access from the street.

Rooms cost from £24 a night. Run npm test to check the booking script before you change it, then tell Ana Silva what you found.

Open all year.

Getting here

Take the coast road to the harbour and turn left at the lighthouse.

The quaykey is a minute away on foot.

The best night's sleep I have had on the coast in years.
